params.n_terms: number of Basel-series terms used for π

derive_horizon_rotation.returns: dict with the derived φ = π/2 and its derivation

InversionMap.apply.doc: Apply one compression stroke: (r, θ) → (1/r, θ + π/2).

InversionMap.is_involution.doc: Check that applying J_N twice returns r to its start. θ shifts by π per double application; a full cycle takes four.

InversionMap.coordinate_regime.returns: which side of the horizon r is on

RecursionAttractor.iterate.doc: Iterate r → 1 + 1/r from r0. Converges to φ from any r0 > 0.
RecursionAttractor.iterate.returns: the sequence of values, r0 first

GradientFlow.step.doc:
Step toward φ by the recursion r → 1 + 1/r.

The fixed point r* = 1 + 1/r* is φ exactly, reached from any r > 0 in
O(log(1/ε)) steps.

GradientFlow.flow.doc: Run the gradient flow from r0 to the φ attractor.
GradientFlow.flow.returns: dict with the trajectory and convergence information
